classification.difficultyReason: Choose a missing corresponding measurement or angle that completes a congruence test.

content.prompt: Add 1 piece of information to each diagram to make the two triangles congruent, and state the congruence test you are using.

spec.description: Side-by-side right triangles in opposing vertical orientations. Vertex labels face outward where possible.
spec.mathematics: Triangle ABC has a right angle at C, AB = 6 m and CB = 3 m. Triangle EFD has a right angle at F and ED = 6 m. EF and FD are unlabelled.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied givens appear; the missing length and test are withheld.

answer.worked: One possible addition is $EF=3\,\mathrm{m}$. The triangles then have equal hypotenuses of $6\,\mathrm{m}$, equal corresponding sides of $3\,\mathrm{m}$ and right angles, so they are congruent by RHS.

spec.description: Side-by-side triangles with angle values inside their corresponding vertices and length labels on the sloping sides.
spec.mathematics: Triangle ABC has angle BAC = 100 degrees and BC = 20 mm. Triangle DEF has angle DEF = 30 degrees, angle EDF = 100 degrees and EF = 20 mm.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle at B remains unlabelled; only supplied givens appear.

answer.worked: Add $\angle ABC=30^\circ$. Then $\angle BAC=\angle EDF=100^\circ$, $\angle ABC=\angle DEF=30^\circ$ and $BC=EF=20\,\mathrm{mm}$. Two pairs of corresponding angles and one pair of corresponding sides are equal, so the triangles are congruent by AAS.

spec.description: Side-by-side triangles with the source orientations and side-label associations. No right-angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Triangle ABC has AB = 9 cm and CB = 7 cm, with AC unlabelled. Triangle FDE has FD = 6 cm, FE = 7 cm and ED = 9 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: AC remains unlabelled; the supplied answer is excluded.

answer.worked: Add $AC=6\,\mathrm{cm}$. Then $AB=DE=9\,\mathrm{cm}$, $BC=EF=7\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $AC=DF=6\,\mathrm{cm}$. Three pairs of corresponding sides are equal, so the triangles are congruent by SSS.

spec.description: Side-by-side triangles retaining the included angle at E and the source side-label associations.
spec.mathematics: Triangle ABC has CA = 26 m and CB = 21 m. Triangle EFG has EF = 21 m, EG = 26 m and angle FEG = 20 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: The angle at C remains unlabelled; only supplied givens appear.

answer.worked: Add $\angle ACB=20^\circ$. Then $CA=EG=26\,\mathrm{m}$, $CB=EF=21\,\mathrm{m}$ and the included angles $\angle ACB$ and $\angle GEF$ are equal. The triangles are congruent by SAS.
